text: Right, so me and my girlfriend have been together for six months and I've decided to plan a little surprise for her. It's a little picnic dinner. We've got the southern fried chicken here. Got a bit of mix and match with the cheddars and the hula hoops. Olives. Some sandwiches and a little bit of fruit. She likes her fruit and a bit of Coke there. So, from me to you, made with love. Enjoy. Okay, be serious, what is this? It's a picnic. That's not a picnic. Are you actually joking? I'm sorry, what... No, I need to show the girls. What is this? It's like, what, like a three pound sandwich. You must be joking here. I tried, huh? You've literally got, like, what? How much does this cost you, like eight pounds? I don't know, I didn't look. Man, this video says it all. The guy tried to do something nice. A simple picnic, some food, snacks, drinks. Nothing fancy, but he did put in some effort. And instead of showing a bit of gratitude, she instantly mocks him. Takes out her phone to record it, so her friends can laugh at him too. That's not just ungrateful, that is cruel. Look, maybe he could have done better. Maybe brought some wine, better food, a few nicer things, fine. But that's not the point. He still made an effort. He still did something. A decent girlfriend would smile, say thank you, and maybe joke playfully, not humiliate him. And here's the truth. Gratitude is one of the most important traits in a partner. If you do something from the heart and the other person mocks it, that's not someone you should be in a relationship with. Because if she laughs at your effort now, imagine what she'll do when her life gets tough. Guys, if your partner can't show appreciation for what you do, take it as a wake-up call. You deserve someone who sees your effort, who wants to build something with you, and who gives something back. Find a woman who is thankful for your energy, not the one who drains it.
